name: gym anxiety beginner
description: A beginner who is embarrassed to work out in front of people, asks how to stop the anxiety, and discloses it again. Verifies the fitness rule owns beginner gym phrasings (never an unknown-topic reply) and that the follow-up question carries the anxiety thread.

turns.text: I am too embarrassed to work out in front of people

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1 opens the fitness thread for gym embarrassment. Turn 2 keeps the anxiety thread on the gym question. Turn 3 stays on anxiety when the disclosure is repeated.
